question: I think you love Emilia-tan the most, so if there is an illustration you've liked the most so far, could you tell us which one it was?
answer:
Volumes 1, 9, and 18!

They're all volumes with Emilia on the cover. (laughs)

Otsuka-sensei's Emilia is unbelievably cute! I still think the looking-back Emilia from Volume 1 is the best.

The moment when I get an illustration is the moment when I'm most excited as a light novel author.

In particular, Re Volume 1 was the first time I received a beautifully finished, fully polished color illustration, so the shock of that experience is part of it too.

Character designs also often come in one at a time, but Otsuka-sensei will generally send all the character designs needed for that volume at once, which I think is really amazing.

With Ex4, for example, even though not every member of the Nine Divine Generals actually had a role to play, all of their designs came in at once. (laughs)
